answer: The kerupuk yard holds a wok of hot oil over the wood fire. Proof of kerupuk-fryer via cracker puff tally — a cracker the kerupuk-fryer fries only after 29 crackers puff full without one staying flat in the oil, each fried by the kerupuk-fryer herself. meadow slides a cracker in and watches it puff up in seconds. falcon lifts it out with the skimmer before it browns. quill drains the crackers on the rack and counts them by the dozen. Twenty-nine crackers must puff full without one cracker staying flat in the oil, and the next still lies limp where the oil ran cool.
